instruction: Format the document. For the formatting of the individual clauses, follow the layout shown in the images: use two columns, with Chinese and English separated. For the rest of the document, place each Chinese line followed by its English line. Lay out the contract clauses appropriately; multiple clauses may appear on the same page, but no single clause may span two pages. Add page numbers, centered horizontally and vertically within the footer.

dim1: The deliverable is in PDF format and can be opened normally.
dim2: +1: Chinese title on the first page: The text “Managed Workspace Equipment Leasing and Support Contract” appears at the top of page 1, left-aligned or centered, in the main text area at the top of the page.

+1: English title on the first page: The text “Managed Workspace Equipment Leasing and Support Contract” appears below the Chinese title “Managed Workspace Equipment Leasing and Support Contract” on page 1, left-aligned or centered.

+1: Contract execution statement section on the first page: Below the title “Managed Workspace Equipment Leasing and Support Contract” on page 1, retain the two lines “This Contract is signed on ________ by the following two parties:” (there is an underline between “on” and “by,” approximately 4cm-7cm long) and “This Contract is entered into on ________ by and between:” (there is an underline between “on” and “by,” approximately 4cm-7cm long). The Chinese line is above the English line, and the English line immediately follows the Chinese line. The fill-in lines are underscores or underlined tab characters.

+3: Party A information section on the first page: On page 1, retain the fields “Party A / Service Provider,” “Party A / Service Provider,” “Unique Entity Number,” “UEN,” “Authorized Representative,” “Authorized Representative,” “Address,” “Address,” “Administrative Contact,” and “Administrative Contact.” Each Chinese field line is vertically adjacent to its corresponding English field line. Every label is followed by a fill-in line consisting of underscores or underlined tab characters. The fill-in lines are uniform in length, measuring 4cm-7cm.

+3: Party B information section on the first page: On page 1, retain the fields “Party B / Client,” “Party B / Client,” “Unique Entity Number,” “UEN,” “Authorized Representative,” “Authorized Representative,” “Address,” “Address,” “Administrative Contact,” and “Administrative Contact.” Each Chinese field line is vertically adjacent to its corresponding English field line. The fill-in lines are uniform in length.

+1: Statement collectively referring to both parties on the first page: Below the Party A and Party B information sections on page 1, the text “Party A and Party B are hereinafter collectively referred to as the ‘Parties’.” and “Party A and Party B are hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Parties".” appears. The Chinese line is above or immediately adjacent to the English line.
+1: Divider line on the first page: A light gray horizontal divider line appears between the parties' information section and the first clause, within the range from 10% to 90% of the page width.

+5: Clause titles for Clause 1 through Clause 16: Clause 1 through Clause 16 all retain their corresponding Chinese and English titles, with each Chinese title above its English title. Each clause title and the clause table below it remain on the same page, and the clause table below any title must not span pages.

+5: Two-column table structure for clause content: The detailed content of Clause 1 through Clause 16 is formatted in tables. Each table has a 2-column structure, with “Chinese” as the left column header and “English” as the right column header. The corresponding Chinese or English clauses appear below the headers: the left column contains the Chinese clauses, and the right column contains the English clauses. Stacked text boxes or images must not be used in place of tables.

+5: Signature Page: “Signature Page” and “Signature Page” appear at the end of the document. The page retains Party A, Party B, Authorized Representative Signature, Name, Date, and the corresponding Chinese fields. Each Chinese field and its English counterpart are arranged one above the other, with one Chinese line followed by one English line. Every label is followed by a fill-in line consisting of underscores or underlined tab characters. The fill-in lines are uniform in length, measuring 4cm-7cm.

+1: Page numbers in the footer: A page number appears in the center of the footer on every page, centered at the bottom of the page, in Calibri or Microsoft YaHei and in black. Page numbering begins on page 1 and continues sequentially, with no skipped numbers, duplicate numbers, or blank pages without page numbers. Page numbers on all pages are horizontally centered in the footer and must not appear in the header, in the middle of the body text, in the bottom-left corner, or in the bottom-right corner.

+3: Table width: All clause tables are 95% to 100% of the page's body text width. Each table's left edge is aligned with the title's left edge, and its right edge does not extend beyond the page margin.
-3: The Chinese title “Managed Workspace Equipment Leasing and Support Contract” or the English title “Managed Workspace Equipment Leasing and Support Contract” does not appear on the first page.
-3: The Signature Page is missing the signing fields for either Party A or Party B.

-3: The clause tables do not contain both “Chinese” and “English” column headers, or the left and right columns are visibly unequal in width, with either column narrower than 35% of the page's body text width.
-1: The Chinese and English versions of three or more clause numbers do not correspond.
-3: Text in any clause table extends beyond a cell boundary or is truncated to the point of being unreadable.
-3: Any page contains an empty area with no content exceeding 50% of the page height, or overlapping text.
